correctness.rationale: Every scalar-normalized projective section among (3^12-1)/2=265720 is tested by the exact homogeneous binary-sextic squarefreeness criterion. The sieve gives 139392 smooth sections and 6096 with all four rational double-cover fibers split. A separately implemented 10368-element split-fiber interpolation census independently reproduces 6096 and all three branch-type totals 3888/1872/336; an explicitly generated 576-element coordinate group partitions all accepted models into 286 orbits and maximal ones into 15. Symbolic gcd checking of all 286 orbit representatives and explicit point enumeration over F9 for each of the 15 maximal orbits support the geometric and zeta claims. Computations are finite and exhaustive within the stated parameter space; no untested infinity claims are made.

value.rationale: The natural moduli object is a genus-two curve with specified degree-two and degree-three ruling maps on P1 x P1. Faber--Grantham determines its maximum possible F3 point count but neither counts extremal embeddings nor classifies their rational automorphism orbits. The 15 complete embedding classes, three Frobenius branch partitions and their different #F9/zeta values, plus the excluded (3,3) type, are an exact natural arithmetic-geometric refinement relevant to explicit genus-two curve construction and small-field model classification. The object and invariants are intrinsic to the specified marked-map family, not an arbitrary coefficient slice.
